Solutions.subtitle: Cyber threats don't pick one entry point and neither do we.
Solutions.protectsTitle: How It Protects Your Critical Infrastructure

unidirectional.description: DFX UDG is a diode-based gateway operating on Zero Trust principles. It physically isolates critical networks, allowing only authorized one-way data transmission.
unidirectional.protects: Secures sensitive infrastructures by completely neutralizing threats and making reverse data flow physically impossible.

secureRemote.description: Built directly upon and seamlessly integrated with DFX UDG hardware, DFX CDS enables request-response based data transmission between isolated networks.
secureRemote.protects: Provides complete and uncompromising control over inter-network data traffic, blocking unauthorized lateral movement.

sandbox.description: DFX Sandbox proactively detects suspicious behavior by continuously monitoring network traffic. It isolates and analyzes suspicious files within a virtual sandbox environment.
sandbox.protects: Safely observes malware behavior and neutralizes cyber threats without risking the actual production environment.

mediaTransfer.description: A physical kiosk guaranteeing the secure use of portable media in sensitive network environments. It deeply inspects and sanitizes portable media before network connection.
mediaTransfer.protects: Physically enforces a 'Zero-USB' policy by detecting and neutralizing malicious payloads before they penetrate the network.

emailSecurity.description: DFX ESP holistically addresses enterprise security needs, combining high precision, flexibility, and control. Built for modern messaging threats.
emailSecurity.protects: Establishes active defense against SPAM, Phishing, BEC (Business Email Compromise), Malware, and Exploit attacks.

intelroom.description: Advanced threat intelligence sharing and analysis room for sophisticated email and network threats.
intelroom.protects: Gathers, analyzes and shares actionable threat intelligence across the entire ecosystem.

trucdr.description: Content Disarm and Reconstruction engine that intercepts files, removes malicious active content, and rebuilds clean files in real-time.
trucdr.protects: Stops zero-day exploits hidden in common file formats by mathematically ensuring only safe components enter.

portableAccess.description: Ensures secure access and data exchange for remote or temporary operators without compromising the core air-gapped network. Built on a strict 'nothing trusted, everything verified' architecture.
portableAccess.protects: Provides continuous authentication and isolation for remote sessions, completely eliminating lateral movement from external or untrusted devices.

hero.tagline: Disarm Weaponized Content. Deliver Safe Files.
hero.subtitle: TrueCDR™ neutralizes file-borne threats before they reach your users, inboxes, shared drives, removable media workflows, and sensitive networks. It removes malicious, active, malformed, and unnecessary risk — then reconstructs safe, usable content for seamless business operations.

problem.label: THE CHALLENGE
problem.title: The File Is Still the Attack Vector

c1.title: Detection Alone Leaves Gaps
c1.text: Antivirus, sandboxing, and threat intelligence depend heavily on known indicators, observed behavior, and detonation timing. Attackers rapidly deploy evasive documents, delayed execution, and malformed structures to bypass traditional layers.

c2.title: Blocking Everything Breaks Business
c2.text: Users need documents, invoices, contracts, and partner content. Blanket blocking creates operational friction, workarounds, and immense pressure on security teams to loosen perimeter controls.

c3.title: Manual Review Doesn't Scale
c3.text: Security teams cannot manually inspect every attachment, upload, or shared file. High-volume environments need repeatable enforcement and audit-ready evidence without endless analyst tickets.

problem.quote:
The question is not simply: 'Is this file malicious?'
The better question is: Can this file be made safe enough to use?

features.label: CAPABILITIES
features.title: Enterprise-Grade CDR
features.desc: Built for real-world enterprise file traffic. Every capability is engineered around a single principle: reconstruct safety, preserve usability.

f1.label: MULTI-FORMAT PROCESSING
f1.text: Handles real enterprise traffic: documents, attachments, uploads, shared files, and deeply nested archives across all common file types.

f2.label: ACTIVE CONTENT NEUTRALIZATION
f2.text: Removes or neutralizes risky active content — macros, scripts, embedded objects, automatic actions, and unsafe links.

f3.label: STRUCTURAL VALIDATION
f3.text: Inspects internal file structures, container relationships, embedded content, malformed components, and hidden internals.

f4.label: RECONSTRUCTION ENGINE
f4.text: Produces a clean, safer, fully functional version of the content — preserving usability while removing unsafe file capabilities.

f5.label: MICROSOFT 365 INTEGRATION
f5.text: Direct, API-driven monitoring and attachment disarming across Exchange Email, SharePoint, and OneDrive workflows.

f6.label: POLICY-BASED CONTROL
f6.text: Configure custom rules for risk outcomes: allow, sanitize, block, quarantine, retain original, or route — based on your security posture.

benefits.label: KEY BENEFITS
benefits.title: Disarm the Risk. Preserve the Work.

b1.title: No Prior Knowledge Required
b1.desc: Security that does not depend on the attacker being known first — effective against zero-days.

b2.title: Business Continuity
b2.desc: Reconstructs safe, usable content rather than forcing files into dead-end quarantines.

b3.title: Deterministic Protection
b3.desc: A non-evadable companion to traditional antivirus, sandboxing, and EDR layers.

b4.title: Flexible Deployment
b4.desc: On-premises, cloud, and hybrid deployments for enterprise IT, regulated networks, and industrial environments.

b5.title: Full Auditability
b5.desc: Clear, file-level processing records and traceable transformation evidence for compliance.

b6.title: Reduced Analyst Load
b6.desc: Automates consistent file handling, eliminating manual attachment triage tickets.

v1.text: Antivirus looks for known signatures. DFX CDR removes dangerous capabilities even when a zero-day is completely unknown.

v2.text: Sandboxing observes behavior in a delayed virtual environment — modern malware evades it. DFX CDR reconstructs the file immediately.

v3.text: Blocking protects but halts business. DFX CDR gives a middle path: remove risky parts, deliver safe reconstructed content.

v4.text: Extraction tools flag or pull metadata. DFX CDR fully transforms risky input into completely safe, usable output.

hero.tagline: Eliminate the USB Risk. Keep the Workflow.
hero.subtitle: In industrial environments, the USB drive is one of the most dangerous and most unavoidable tools on the production floor. DFX Portable Access Security System replaces it entirely: a hardened, policy-driven data bridge that enables secure, encrypted, and fully auditable file transfers across your most sensitive networks without a single uncontrolled USB connection.

overview.title: DFX Portable Access Security System
overview.desc: A hardware-based Zero Trust secure data bridge purpose-built for industrial and operational environments where uncontrolled USB usage represents an unacceptable risk.

c1.label: ELIMINATES USB RISK
c1.text: Replaces traditional USB transfers with a centrally governed, AES-256 encrypted, and NFC-enabled data bridge, removing the physical attack vector.

c2.label: HARDWARE SECURITY
c2.text: Built on a FIPS-compliant TPM module and a hardened operating system designed to resist even the most advanced adversarial techniques.

c3.label: SEAMLESS INTEGRATION
c3.text: Operates seamlessly with DFX Unidirectional Gateway, ensuring data moves only in the authorized direction, combining portability with unidirectional security.

animation.label: Workflow
animation.title: How It Works
animation.desc: Unlike traditional removable media controls that restrict behavior through software policies, it eliminates the physical attack vector entirely.

problem.label: The Problem
problem.title: Why USB is an Unacceptable Risk
problem.desc: In critical industrial environments, the USB drive remains one of the most persistent and underestimated attack vectors. It bypasses perimeter defenses entirely.

c1.title: Physical Malware Transmission
c1.text: A single infected USB drive can introduce ransomware, destructive malware, or espionage tools directly into air-gapped OT networks, leading to production shutdowns, equipment damage, and severe threats to operational safety.

c2.title: Unauthorized Data Leakage
c2.text: Removable media bypasses network perimeters and data loss prevention (DLP) systems, making it dangerously easy for sensitive intellectual property, operational data, or credentials to be extracted from secure environments without detection.

c3.title: Inefficiency of Traditional AV
c3.text: Traditional Antivirus depends heavily on known signatures and takes time to detect new threats. It often fails to block zero-day malware or targeted attacks hidden on USB drives before they execute and compromise the system.

c1.title: Secure Firmware Updates
c1.text: When vendors need to patch critical ICS/SCADA equipment, it ensures that only verified, malware-free firmware enters the OT environment, with a permanent cryptographic record of the transaction.

c2.title: Log & Telemetry Extraction
c2.text: Operators can securely extract operational data, system logs, or compliance reports from highly isolated zones for analysis in the IT network, without creating a two-way connection.

c3.title: Air-Gapped Workstations
c3.text: In defense and intelligence applications, it provides the only approved method for moving mission-critical intelligence across physically separated classification domains.

f1.title: Zero USB Policy
f1.desc: Eliminates physical USB usage on the production floor entirely, closing one of industrial security's most persistent attack vectors while giving operational teams a fast alternative.

f2.title: Military-Grade Encryption
f2.desc: Every file is secured with AES-256 encryption and RSA-2048 digital signature verification, ensuring data cannot be intercepted, tampered with, or replayed in transit.

f3.title: Full Traceability
f3.desc: Real-time visibility into who transferred which file, when, and to which machine. Audit-ready logs support compliance with NIS2, IEC 62443, and internal security policies.

f4.title: Hardware-Level Protection
f4.desc: Built on a FIPS-compliant TPM module and a hardened operating system, it is engineered to resist advanced persistent threats, tampering, and physical attack.

f5.title: Seamless Integration with DFX Unidirectional Gateway
f5.desc: Transfers files via a built-in data diode path, ensuring data moves only in the authorized direction combining the operational convenience of a portable device with the hardware-enforced security of a unidirectional gateway.

part1.description: DataFlowX is a cybersecurity company focused on securing critical infrastructures and enabling safe, controlled data flow between IT and OT environments.

part2.title: Who We Are?
part2.p1: We develop next-generation solutions built on Zero Trust architecture and AI-driven threat intelligence that designed for organizations where security is not optional.
part2.p2: We serve sectors where operational continuity and data integrity are mission-critical: energy, finance, manufacturing, and defense. part2.p3: We believe that security should not slow organizations down contrary it should make them stronger. That belief drives everything we build.

Testimonials.title: موثوق به من قبل
Testimonials.subtitle: استمع إلى كيف تقوم المؤسسات في جميع أنحاء العالم بتأمين بنيتها التحتية الحيوية وبياناتها المهمة مع DataFlowX.

t1.text: لقد غيّر حل البوابة الأحادية الاتجاه من DataFlowX أمن شبكة التكنولوجيا التشغيلية (OT) لدينا بالكامل. يمكننا الآن تصدير بيانات الإنتاج في الوقت الفعلي بأمان دون تعريض أنظمة التحكم الصناعية الحرجة للتهديدات الخارجية.

t2.text: يلتقط حل الصندوق الرملي (Sandbox) تهديدات اليوم الصفر التي فاتها الموردون السابقون. قدرته على محاكاة السلوك البشري والتهرب من الاكتشاف بواسطة البرامج الضارة المتقدمة تُعد نقطة تحول حقيقية لفريق عمليات الأمن (SOC) لدينا.

t3.text: أتاح لنا تنفيذ الوصول عن بعد الآمن من DataFlowX الحفاظ على قنوات اتصال آمنة بين مستويات التصنيف المختلفة. راحة البال التي يجلبها للبنية التحتية الدفاعية لدينا لا تقدر بثمن.
